title: license file
description: A license file on disk, as nw-licenser writes it and mankit's licenses package reads it: a Resource (ADR-S15) whose spec holds the payload's bytes exactly as signed and the Ed25519 signature over them, so an app checks the file offline against the keys its build trusts (ADR-L1, L5, L6). The signature covers the payload alone. Stored at the org's or the app's place (ADR-L8). Several app versions read it at once: apiVersion, kind and metadata never change; spec may grow (ADR-S15). A file that is not this shape is refused as unreadable.

apiVersion.description: The form the file is in, so a reader knows which schema it meets (ADR-S15, apiversion/v1/forms.yaml).

kind.description: Always License, the kind of this file.

id.description: The license's id: always the same as the signed payload's id, so a signed id names the file; mankit refuses a file whose two ids differ.

spec.description: The signed license: the payload's bytes and the signature over them, and for a release-trial the unsigned record of the trial it started. Open: a newer nw-licenser or app may add fields here, and an older app accepts them (CT-RULE-4).

payload.description: The signed bytes, standard base64: JSON that meets license-payload.schema.json. Kept as bytes, not as an object, so the signature is checked over exactly what was signed.

signature.description: The Ed25519 signature over the payload's bytes, standard base64: 64 bytes, so 88 characters ending ==, made with the key the payload's keyId names (ADR-L1, L6).

started.description: The trial this file started, written by the app beside the signed payload (ADR-L9). The signing tool writes the file without it; the app adds it when it writes its built-in release-trial key as its license file on a start with no license, and writes it anew when the app is reinstalled or updated. Unsigned, as the key is signed once per product line but a trial starts once per install: the signature covers the payload alone, so this record never breaks it. Editing it can stretch a trial; it gains no more than a reinstall, which gives a fresh trial (ADR-L9), and it never opens more than the signed payload names. A rule no schema can say, as the kind sits inside the signed payload: only a release-trial's file has it. Open: a newer app may add fields here, and an older app accepts them (CT-RULE-4).

day.description: The day the trial started, an RFC 3339 date in UTC, never after the payload's until. The trial runs the payload's days from it, so license-show.schema.json's licenses[].until for this file is reckoned from it.

binary.description: The path of the app binary that started the trial, so a reader sees which install started it.

fileTime.description: That binary's file time (its last modification) when the trial started, RFC 3339. Installs write binaries fresh, so a reinstall or an update gives a new time, by which the app tells a new install from the one that started the trial.
